description: This file defines the RAMClient class for interacting with AWS Resource Access Manager service, including method signatures for various operations.

classes.name: RAMClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Resource Access Manager, providing methods to interact with the service.

methods.name: acceptResourceShareInvitation
methods.description: Accept an invitation to share a resource.

methods.description: Create a new permission for resource sharing.

methods.name: getResourceShareInvitations
methods.description: Retrieve invitations to join resource shares.
